answer: Re-attestations are stored in comet and summit lists each lapse. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the tundra graph. Standing lapses unless 5 peers re-attest it every 4 epochs, so holding a position requires ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 984 impostors cost 1472 times the honest price and take 12 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
